title: Carrie
author: Stephen King
current_text: In 1975, someone challenged Carrie at Clark High School in Las Vegas, calling it “trash” and low-value literature; it was removed from the school library.

sources.quote: The first recorded challenge was in 1975 at Clark High School in Las Vegas. Somebody considered “Carrie” to be low-value literature. They called it “trash” and it was removed from the school library.
sources.title: Stephen King exclusive: 'Carrie,' his first horror novel, turns 50
